<thought>We need to find the template that matches the described DIBAL-H reduction (ester to aldehyde, breaking a C-O bond and reducing bond order). We'll search the template catalog using these functional group criteria and then retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde", "aliphatic hydroxyl"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C-O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
